name: Agents at work
oneLiner: a glass goal card with its own bar, then 3 to 5 agent rows with drawn glyph tiles stagger in; each agent's bar fills at its own speed, a check pops as it hits 100%, the goal bar climbs a notch per agent and its check slams last with a stamp
say: when the speaker says several agents work on one goal at once ('it spins up five agents in the background'): cut in on the goal, the last check and stamp land on 'done' or 'and it's finished'. 9:16 also takes layout top (graphic in the upper ~45%, speaker below)
